package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// LessonVersionRepoPG implements LessonVersionRepository.
type LessonVersionRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r LessonVersionRepoPG) ReplaceByLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string, versions []domain.LessonVersion) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_version WHERE lesson_id=$1`, lessonID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, version := range versions {
		status := version.Status
		if status != domain.LessonVersionStatusNoActive && status != domain.LessonVersionStatusActive {
			status = domain.LessonVersionStatusActive
		}
		createdAt := version.CreatedAt
		if createdAt.IsZero() {
			createdAt = time.Now().UTC()
		}
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO lesson_version (lesson_id, tech_version_id, status, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)`,
			lessonID, version.TechVersionID, status, createdAt); err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r LessonVersionRepoPG) ListByLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.LessonVersion, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `SELECT lesson_id, tech_version_id, status, created_at FROM lesson_version WHERE lesson_id=$1 ORDER BY tech_version_id`, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := []domain.LessonVersion{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var version domain.LessonVersion
		if err := rows.Scan(&version.LessonID, &version.TechVersionID, &version.Status, &version.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, version)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

var _ repository.LessonVersionRepository = (*LessonVersionRepoPG)(nil)
